paper_reference: Yan et al., Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation.
license: not declared in repository at pinned commit; treat as not redistributable until clarified
installation_command: git clone https://github.com/HuskyInSalt/CRAG.git external/CRAG && git -C external/CRAG checkout de7c2961ae624a1483a138c5798e1f6d0c4fb0e0 && python -m venv external/envs/crag && external/envs/crag/bin/pip install -r external/CRAG/requirements.txt
isolation: Use a dedicated virtual environment under external/envs/crag or a container because CRAG dependencies may conflict with project dependencies.
model_retriever_requirements: Official CRAG evaluator/retriever/generator dependencies at the pinned commit.
Generator and retrieval resources required by the official release.
A JSON-stdin runner wrapper that calls the official CRAG code at the pinned commit.

expected_output_mapping.stdin: JSON object with baseline_id, comparison_mode, session_id, query, target_time, evidence, budgets, and native_config.
expected_output_mapping.stdout: JSON object. Required: answer or final_answer. Optional: predicted_state/state, confidence, predicted_hypothesis_id, citation_supported, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd.
expected_output_mapping.state: No dispute/evolution state is assumed unless the official wrapper explicitly emits it.
expected_output_mapping.comparison_mode: controlled uses common evidence; native uses official CRAG retrieval/correction configuration.

readiness_notes: The pinned repository does not declare a license file, so native execution should be blocked in shared artifacts until license status is clarified. Configure runner_command to a wrapper around the pinned checkout.

state_support.abstain: native only if the wrapper maps official CRAG correction/no-answer behavior to abstain
state_support.unknown: evaluator_derived when no native state is emitted
